title: bt-events-attendee-builder.html
content: Are your potential {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s related to {{variable.Object_Account}} s, {{variable.Object_Contact}} s, {{variable.Object_Campaign}} s, {{variable.Object_Event}} s, {{variable.Object_Lead}} s, or Reports? Use the {{variable.Component_BTEVAttendeeBuilder}} component to add {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s directly to an {{variable.Object_Event}} from the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Add the Component Complete the following steps if the {{variable.Component_BTEVAttendeeBuilder}} component hasn’t been added to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} . Click Edit Page . Locate the {{variable.Component_BTEVAttendeeBuilder}} under custom components.   Drag and drop the component onto the screen. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Add Attendees Are you using reports? The first column of a report must include the Record ID for each individual/record. If the first column doesn’t contain the Record ID, the following can occur. An import will fail silently when uploading Attendees to an Event via an Attendee/Lead/Contact report. Duplicate Attendee records can be added. Return to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click Attendees or the {{variable.Component_BTEVAttendeeBuilder}} component. Click in the Add Attendees field.   Enter a name. Look through the list of potential names. Select a name. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} once you are done adding names.   Click the Attendees Related List.   Each newly added {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will have the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} set to “To Invite.”
